chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever is killed defending his right (from oppression), he is a martyr.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a person killed while defending their rights from oppression?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this hadith to define martyrdom broadly, extending it beyond battlefield death to include those killed while defending their specific right (*mazlimah*) from injustice. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *adl* (justice) and the spiritual elevation of enduring oppression, linking the individual's struggle for rights to the broader cosmic conflict between truth and falsehood.
